BSSN Grid Module

BSSN-based numerical relativity infrastructure for evolving Einstein's equations.

BSSN-based numerical relativity infrastructure for evolving Einstein's equations.

This module implements the Baumgarte–Shapiro–Shibata–Nakamura (BSSN) formulation of the 3+1 Einstein equations:

\[R_{ij} = \tilde{R}_{ij} + R^{\chi}_{ij} \]

with the conformal decomposition:

\[\gamma_{ij} = \chi^{-1} \tilde{\gamma}_{ij}, \quad \det(\tilde{\gamma}) = 1 \]

Stored variables:

  • Conformal metric \( \tilde{\gamma}_{ij} \)
  • Conformal factor \( \chi = e^{-4\phi} \)
  • Trace-free curvature \( \tilde{A}_{ij} \)
  • Mean curvature \( K \)
  • Contracted Christoffels \( \tilde{\Gamma}^i \)
  • Gauge: lapse \( \alpha \), shift \( \beta^i \)

Architecture:

  • Structure-of-Arrays (SoA) grid layout
  • Halo / ghost zones for finite differences
  • Cached geometric tensors (\tilde{\Gamma}, Ricci, constraints)
  • RK4 time integration

Numerics:

  • Centered finite differences
  • Kreiss–Oliger dissipation
  • Constraint monitoring
Note
This documentation follows the conventions of Alcubierre (2008).
